notes.title: Welcome to the Solarpunk Singleplayer Playtest! ☀️
notes.content:
[h2]🎮 Singleplayer Playtest (Alpha) begins NOW![/h2][p]We’ve got some wonderful news for our Kickstarter Alpha Backer: the Solarpunk singleplayer playtest for [b]Kickstarter Alpha-Test backers[/b] is officially starting NOW! 🎉 Yes, exactly, NOW!  

This playtest is singleplayer only, and all backers who selected Alpha Access during the Kickstarter are invited. You should have received your keys back in January (for the alpha demo). Keep in mind: this is an alpha version – bugs may occur and some features are still incomplete.  [/p][p][/p][p]👉 To join, simply update your Steam playtest build (Alpha Access backers only), restart Steam, and you’ll immediately have access to the latest playtest version.  [/p][p]⚡ Didn’t redeem your Steam key yet? Check your inbox for the email from Backerkit (sent in January). If you can’t find it, also check your spam folder. Lost your email? You can recover it here: [url="https://solarpunk.backerkit.com/"]https://solarpunk.backerkit.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]  [b]🔗 Full news & details for all Kickstarter backer:[/b] [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cyberwave/solarpunk-survival-craft-game-in-world-of-floating-island/posts/4475025"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cyberwave/solarpunk-survival-craft-game-in-world-of-floating-island/posts/4475025[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Thinking about giving away some FREE alpha keys for non Kickstarter backers… Who wants in?[/h2][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🌿 What’s new since the last News? [/b][/h3][p align="start"]In the meantime, we definitely didn’t sleep on development! We’ve been working hard to improve and expand Solarpunk. Some of the highlights include:[/p][list][*][p]Character Editor is now in the game (Basic)[/p][/*][*][p]Basic controller support has been added (with a virtual cursor for now)[/p][/*][*][p]Animal care improved: new round feeding & water stations, plus smarter AI so animals find and use them correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fresh new assets: updated crops (tomatoes & peppers), new trophy models, and polished item icons[/p][/*][*][p]Immersion upgrades: new music tracks added for an even cozier atmosphere[/p][/*][*][p]And of course… many smaller tweaks and fixes behind the scenes to make the game smoother and more fun to play.[/p][/*][*][p]We have incorporated the Kickstarter backer designs and/or skins into the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/2b87122698624bb255254dbcf828d84ac1d60440.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/04572f3d13b807a561b551d5246d11e1644c4fd0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/69eb261681dc71360519e48bab56ca4b8e5b2636.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/1caf9d46c900a8a862ee589f74df9e4b299d1dca.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]💪 What’s Next?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]This singleplayer playtest is the first big step with our community onboard. Your feedback will directly help us refine balancing, polish features, and improve the overall experience. Every insight you share is a seed that helps Solarpunk grow into the cozy, beautiful world we all want it to be.[/p][p align="start"][b]The multiplayer playtest will take place in a few weeks, depending on your feedback, among other things.[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]We know many of you have been eagerly waiting for a release date, and we truly appreciate your patience during this long journey. Before we commit to announcing one, we want to make sure that Solarpunk feels right in your hands. That’s why our next big step will be the upcoming playtests. Once we’ve gathered your feedback and ensured the game is stable and enjoyable, we’ll finally be ready to share a proper release date with you.
[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/bff270f8936cf21ae9cb5e9fb8e542924bc77237.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][url="https://cozygamescelebration.beehiiv.com/" style="button"]☕ Cozy & Family Friendly Games Newsletter[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and to shape Solarpunk together. 💚 With love and gratitude, The Solarpunk Team 🌱[/p]

notes.title: 🌱 Solarpunk Dev Update – Logic Systems, Animals & New Recipes!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re back with a big development update. A lot has happened over the past few weeks, and the world of Solarpunk is really coming together. Let’s jump right in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/72bf2c2bfd8bd758411870d001cb3fa6d845d419.jpg[/img]
[i](Take a look at the trade bot!)[/i]

[h2]⚡ Advanced Power Logic[/h2]

We have implemented a[b] brand-new logic system for electricity[/b]! You can now use switches to turn entire networks (or parts of them) on and off, plus new sensors add some real automation magic:

[list]
[*] [b]Rain sensors[/b] that can disable sprinklers when it rains
[*] [b]Day/Night sensors[/b] to automatically turn on your lights at night
[*] The system opens up creative possibilities!
[*] There’s also now an electric version of the furnace, instead of using materials, it runs on electricity.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/dd8e78c31cd083f991579eb9aeed157cedb35604.png[/img]
[i](WIP: Electric furnace concept)[/i]

[h2]🐮 Animals Are (Almost) Here![/h2]

We have also been working hard on our [b]animal systems[/b], and here’s what’s already in place:

[list]
[*] Animals are now [b]implemented on the programming side[/b] and ready for testing
[*] We implemented the[b] breeding system[/b]
[*] Happy animals produce loot
[*] Animals get a random name when they spawn – but you can rename them using an Animal Tag
[*] [b]Animal transport [/b]is now possible! You can use a Transport Item to send animals to a [b]Receiving Station[/b] you place anywhere on your base
[*] Certain items (like the Beehive) can now only be placed in specific biomes. No bees in the snowy mountains, it's just too cold!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/c1dd7e0a6e96dae714acba9bdde9c493d5902325.jpg[/img]
[i](WIP: Drones can now help you automate processes.)[/i]

[h2]🍅 New Crops & Cooking System[/h2]

After some spontaneous consideration, we decided to [b]add a cooking system[/b] to the game to give it even more depth. We’ve added several new plants like [b]tomatoes, carrots, paprika, and watermelon. [/b]

The first version of the cooking system now has [b]10 recipes[/b] that offer useful bonuses (like reduced hunger or thirst for a few minutes).

[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes & Performance Improvements[/h2]

While one of us focused on new features, the other has been deep in balancing and polishing.
Most of the changes are [b]small but impactful[/b]. Here are a few examples:

[list]
[*] You only [b]respawn in bed[/b] if it’s actually inside a house with a floor (no more falling into the void!)
[*] A [b]Recycler[/b] lets you turn almost anything into "[b]Recycling Points[/b]" (name might change). You’ll use these points to unlock skins and fun extras from the vending machine
[*] Airship repair kits work again and are easier to use
[*] New item icons, recipes, and tutorial text
[*] Balanced airship stats and trading quests
[*] Fixed bugs, improved island positioning, and added new plants
[*] Now, when you die, you drop your items with a [b]particle effect[/b] so you can easily find them again
[*] Several bugs in the energy system have been ironed out
[*] Fixed a crash related to inventory items and crafting/rewards
[*] Starving in the airship now works correctly
[*] [b]Diamond tools[/b] are finally fully functional
[*] Performance has been significantly improved across the board
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/1034457faf25dd21cf64b11af73e02e4c0df5f32.jpg[/img]
[i](WIP: We added maps to the game so you can locate islands and you can set your own markers.)[/i]

That’s it for now! Thank you so much for your ongoing support and patience. Every update brings us closer to a world we can't wait to share with you. 

For even more exchange or if you have any questions, join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/eCVtRG62eu][b]Discord server[/b][/url] 👈
and become part of the Solarpunk community.

Until next time,

The Solarpunk Team

notes.title: Thank You for 100k+ Demo Downloads! 🌱
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re back with a quick but exciting update!
 
[h2]🌟 Over 100,000 Demo Downloads![/h2]

Our demo made it into the [b]Top 5 most downloaded games[/b] during the Steam Next Fest! As just two developers, this means the world to us. Competing alongside big studios wouldn't have been possible without [b]YOUR incredible support[/b]. 

Thank you so much for playing, sharing, and believing in Solarpunk!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/1f15c7503b3abe71f6108b9d5bae6133112b99d6.png[/img]

[h2]🎥 Gamestar Showcase Feature[/h2]

We were recently featured in the Gamestar Showcase. While the original video is in German, [b]we’re preparing an English version just for you[/b] and will share it with you soon! 

[b]Follow us[/b] on [url=https://x.com/Solarpunk_Game]X[/url] to or join our [url=https://discord.gg/eCVtRG62eu]Discord[/url] server to never miss any news again. 

[h2]🛠️ What We've Been Working On[/h2]

Development has been full steam ahead, with[b] many new features and improvements[/b]:

- A reworked airship system, including weather challenges and upgrade paths
- Storm mechanics that damage crops unless protected, this makes greenhouses now essential!
- New tradebot system, UI improvements, and more meaningful crafting/trading
- An improved tutorial and more intuitive starting area
- Tons of gameplay balancing, quest design, and bug fixes to polish the experience

We're testing a lot of internal changes to make Solarpunk feel smoother and more fun. 
So far, it's working great!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/2b64a811af63f6872acccec159fa3592fa2cab8c.png[/img]

At the end we would like to point out that we will do our best to keep you up to date with regular updates on Kickstarter. But since it’s just the two of us, [b]we’re putting all our time and energy into developing the game[/b]. We promise: every quiet moment is a busy one behind the scenes.

Thank you again for being part of this journey. Your support keeps us going, and we can’t wait to share more very soon. 💚

– Your Solarpunk Team

notes.title: Steam Next Fest! ☀️ Solarpunk Demo launches on Monday
notes.content:
[b]Hey Community,[/b]

It's happening! Starting Monday, you can play the first-ever Solarpunk demo during the Steam Next Fest. Begin your adventure on a floating island, gather resources, build your base, research new technologies, and fly your very own airship to explore other islands.

[h3]What to expect in the demo:[/h3]
✔️ Craft your first items, farm, and build your base
✔️ The building system is included – create your first home
✔️ Test the airship and explore the world
✔️ Use solar panels, wind turbines, and other sustainable energy sources
✔️ Experience a dynamic weather system that affects gameplay

[h3]What's next:[/h3]
This demo gives you a first taste of Solarpunk, but there’s so much more to come! Some features and items are not included yet, and multiplayer is still in development. Your feedback helps us improve the game and make the world of Solarpunk even more exciting!

[h3]How you can support us:[/h3]
Your feedback is super important to us! Play the demo, test various mechanics, and let us know what you like or what could be improved. Reach out to us directly on Steam or join our [url=https://discord.gg/eu5srZ5RxU]Discord[/url]!

We’re excited to see your creations and discoveries!

notes.title: Energy system online, new building materials & how we make a Island!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Solarpunk Community,[/h3]

We’re thrilled to bring you another development update for Solarpunk! Let’s dive into the latest progress and new features we’ve been working on.

[previewyoutube=SpcSmddLjqI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]In the devlog, we cover the following points:[/h3]
[b]⚡ Renewable Energy System:[/b] We’re excited to share that the solar panels and wind turbines in the game are now fully functional! Previously, we only demonstrated how the energy system would work, but now it truly powers your gadgets like weather stations, sprinklers, and lights. We’re also working on wireless power to make your homes even tidier without all the cables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/09efe99e17d4f485dc466b776b9a49d76d86a5c6.png[/img][i]Here our "Network Display"[/i]

[b]🤖 New Tools for Automation:[/b] The automatic drill and automatic magnet fisher are now fully functional. These tools will make resource gathering easier, allowing you to spend more time exploring and building.

[b]🏠 Building Plus Update:[/b] Thanks to our Kickstarter supporters, we’ve added new building materials, including brick and glass. We also added more decorations, giving you more ways to make your homes unique and cozy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/37a04779ec6dd2563d0daadcacfa4c47975b9d73.png[/img][i]All 3 materials combined. (See more of the "building plus update" in the video).[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/9deefd8023c153d32b2070b4d1b1e928db374aa5.png[/img][i]We also added more decorations[/i]

[b]🎉 Gamescom Highlights:[/b] We already told you about this in the last Devlog but Gamescom was an incredible experience for us. We even had a German TV crew follow us for a day, and we got to showcase Solarpunk to the press and content creators. Your enthusiasm means the world to us!

[b]🌴 New Islands:[/b] We’re currently working on new islands to make exploration even more exciting. Each island will be unique, with new resources, plants, and animals to discover. Here an clip, how we build an island in Unreal Engine 5 for Solarpunk.

[previewyoutube=Yeh3w7BAInk;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have any questions about the development, please join our Discord server! Here we can answer your feedback and questions directly. 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/rokaplay]DISCORD ↗️[/url]

Until next time, your Cyberwave & rokaplay team 💪

notes.title: 🏠 Huge building system update, We won 2 OTK Awards, New Trailer
notes.content:
Hello Solarpunk Community 👋!

We've made significant advancements to our building system over the past few weeks, transitioning from collision channels to a tag-snap system. This gives users much more freedom when building their dream homes in Solarpunk.
[previewyoutube=CTjgLXj2VXE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]📑 Summary of what we have done in the last weeks![/h3]
[list]
[*] Building System
[olist]
[*] [b]Changed the building system from collision channels to a tag snap system.[/b] So we theoretically have an infinite number of snap possibilities for example: Walls, roof slopes, columns, decorations, plants, electronic components and so on. Previously we were very limited in this respect.
[*] There is now a system with which buildings can have special rules for building in individual cases. [b]For example, carpets can be placed under furniture if the furniture is already in place. [/b]Wall shelves automatically rotate towards the wall so that they hang from it. Hanging plants can only be hung from the ceiling up to a certain angle and so on.
[*] A system has been built in which ensures that buildables like decorations, cannot be built into each other. Due to a limitation in the Unreal engine, dynamic previews that have not yet been built can only have "simple collisions", which consist of boxes or similar simple shapes.[b] However, we wanted it to be possible to place a candle on the edge of a furnace (for example).[/b] We therefore developed the system so that every buildable object has two possible collisions. A simple one for building and a complex (much more precise) one when the object is built. This way we can have the best of both worlds if necessary.
[/olist]
[/list][list]
[*] Building preview is no longer displayed if you have a placeable in your hand and a UI open
[*] "Building rules" such as "Can only be built on land" or "Can only be built on water" have been added.
[*][b] Floating water drone rework[/b] (which you can already see in the trailers). Now has floats that limit the area in which the drone fishes items out of the water and a box in which the drone brings the items, where you can then collect them as a player.
[*] [b]Sky environment improved.[/b] Clouds have been reworked. The sun now shines through the clouds better and adapts to the colour mood of the sun.
[*][b] Weather system improved.[/b] Now have more control over weather changes and leaves and sticks fly through the air during thunderstorms
[*] [b]System prototyped so that you can be hit by whirling objects in a storm and take damage.[/b] It also takes into account the direction the wind is coming from, so you can take cover behind hills or walls from flying things.
[/list]
[h3]🤗 We won a custom made PC & $10.000[/h3]
During the OTK Games Expo, an event hosted by the Youtuber Asmongold, the community voted Solarpunk as "Best Trailer" and we won $10.000. We also won an Award for "Most unique Artstyle" and we will receive a custom made Solarpunk-themed PC from Starforge System. Over 300.000 people watched the event live and we are so incredibly grateful for our community.  You are amazing 😍!
[previewyoutube=jLKCR676xU0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]📹The latest trailer[/h3]
In the light of the Games baked in Germany Steam event we have created a new trailer. You can watch it here.
[previewyoutube=U5tVI1RN1cY;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope you enjoyed the news here and leave us a comment or your opinion on what you would like to know in the next update.

[b]You can always join our Dev-Discord and ask us what we are currently working on.[/b]
Join us on Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/8wPsjDxTyQ]https://discord.gg/8wPsjDxTyQ[/url]

Best regards
Cyberwave & rokaplay Team

notes.title: New Devlog, Merchant platform reworked, reached over 400.000 Wishlist on Steam💪
notes.content:
Hello Solarpunk Community!

[b]First of all, we wanted to apologies for the long wait. We are currently working on so many things at once, that we simply didn’t had the time. The next devlog should be released much faster.[/b]

We're thrilled to share some exciting updates with you regarding the Merchant in our game. We've undergone a complete visual and content overhaul to bring you a more immersive and engaging experience. 

[previewyoutube=inUb5LVF2ws;full][/previewyoutube][i]🎥 Watch the 3min devlog on Youtube or read further![/i]

Visually, the Merchant platform has been expanded, now boasting a charming little front garden. Inside, the interior design has been meticulously crafted, and we've even added a second room for the cockpit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/41055fb6a52abfb69a54d3a4480ed35413cea93f.jpg[/img]
[i]ℹ️Cockpit[/i]

As we really want the player to feel stranded in our world we removed the merchant NPC and improved the merchant plattform. It now represents a derelict, abandoned hub wandering aimlessly through the world. Accessible only by the player's Airship, it hosts various electrical devices that players must repair to utilize. Within the shop lies a malfunctioning scanner. Once repaired, players can scan "electrical components" found on islands, unlocking invaluable information and new recipes for technical components like Solar Panels and Farmbots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/dfec2c0072aef340df8c57a5075f07c2f01154f9.jpg[/img]
[i]ℹ️Repair the scanner, to get access to new blueprints![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/6b8a44c38de0cd06d5a5856a5330d6be94139144.jpg[/img]

We've even included a little Easter egg and immortalised our first game in the cockpit. Which, by the way, is available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1212410/Hourglass/]Steam[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1212410/Hourglass/
[i]ℹ️Our first game "Hourglass"[/i]

Out in the front garden, players will find an old vending machine. Repairing it rewards players with skins for their Airship, Farmbot, and flowerpots. Additionally, a Fabricator stands nearby, essential for enhancing the player's Airship. We are sure that all these changes and improvements help to get a better player experience.

We've also implemented numerous quality-of-life improvements. Players can now split stacks by right-clicking, drop individual items from hand to inventory slots, and automatically drop items that no longer fit in the inventory. Furthermore, with a simple Shift + Left-click, players can seamlessly transfer items between their hotbar, inventory, and storage containers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/1f036ed9c83f5ebfef37e8cf04c7b24b2646e235.jpg[/img]
[i]ℹ️Inventory .... inspired by Minecraft![/i]

We're also excited to announce the addition of a respawn system. If a player perishes due to hunger or falling from great heights, they'll drop all of their items, retrievable for a limited time. However, crashes with the Airship or falls from islands will result in items being lost permanently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/2b1fe5d95d43d06a7b3e1823aa2b8cf7e16b8ffa.jpg[/img]
[i]ℹ️Items lying on the ground after you die and respawn.[/i]

And last but not least, we've addressed various bugs and made significant performance optimizations. Just to list a few of these, we:

[list]
[*] prevented the spamming of the water can
[*] refined our demolition mechanics (including different sounds for things you demolish)
[*] prevented the “building preview” to be displayed “in your face” after crafting one at the crafting table
[*] added water particles at growboxes or farmlands for better visual feedback
[*] added a feature that prevents important (not craftable) items from getting lost if the player falls of an island
[*] added a standing torch that can be refueled
[*] fixed a bug where mouse sensitivity set by the player would not load correctly
[*] fixed a bug where taking water out of a rain collector with a watering can would not update the rain collectors visual water level
[*] implemented a feature where the “load world” dialogue now accepts savefiles you put in the folder by yourself (outside of the game. If you are sending your save to a friend for example)
[*] fixed some audio bugs
[*] fixed not beeing able to open the crafting menu when the player has a “placeable” in his hand
[*] and much more 
[/list]
We are also finalizing our building system rework. We’ve done a lot to make the building experience much more fun and we cannot wait to show this to you in the next devlog. Take a look at those sneak peek images in the meantime: 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/ac0f99c94fe28c5a50305c8d221c0bafd23bb4d1.jpg[/img]

[h3]💪 400.000 Wishlist on Steam[/h3]
We just reached 400.000 wishlists on Steam for Solarpunk - that's incredible. Thank you so much! We are beyond happy for all your support! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/1bbe189b0f94a2c51c3414722b1a59be767bae27.jpg[/img]
Thank you for your patience and continued support as we work tirelessly to bring you the best Solarpunk experience possible!

Best regards
Cyberwave & rokaplay Team

notes.title: Devlog: We are making significant progress
notes.content:
Dear Solarpunk Community,

We sincerely apologise for the delay and thank you for your patience. With today's update we've brought you a lot too. We've been working behind the scenes and look forward to showing you what we've been up to. But first, we have to adress the alpha version of Solarpunk.

[h2]🎬 Solarpunk update / devlog[/h2]
We have created a devlog video for you, but for all those who prefer to read a text, we have also listed all the changes.

[previewyoutube=hljb8cbn3pw;full]https://youtu.be/hljb8cbn3pw?si=bOn-RRR_p0xBJMJo[/previewyoutube]

Since our Kickstarter campaign, we've accomplished a lot. Here's a rundown of the key developments since the end of the Kickstarter:

[h3]User Interface (UI) Overhaul:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Revamped UI for easier navigation, including main menu, player inventory, chest inventory, furnace, research table, crafting menu, and more.
[*] Added functionality to display recipes not craftable at the current location (some recipes need a crafting table, others can be crafted without a crafting table).
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Enhancements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Research system: Unlock new crafting recipes at the research table.
[*] Fishing: Introducing the magnet fishing rod for catching useful items in lakes.
[*] Chickens: Now with dynamic behaviors, including following wheat trails, seeking shelter at night, and taking cover during rain.
[*] Bed feature: Skip the night by resting in a bed.
[*] Furnace: Smelt ores and clay for crafting.
[*] Expanded crafting recipes for decorative items like sofas, tables, and flower pots.
[*] Redesigned airship with enhanced features.
[*] Trees now yield different loot based on growth stages.
[*] Player effects system: Temporarily alter gameplay mechanics based on environmental conditions.
[*] Watering can refillable at rivers or rain collectors.
[*] Added various sound effects for immersive gameplay.
[*] Introduction of new resources like clay, leaves, wheat, bread, bricks, metal scrap, and more.
[*] Objects requiring water (rain collectors, grow boxes, farmland, water troughs) now detect rainfall and shelter status.
[/list]

[h3]Additional Improvements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Performance optimizations, including imposter meshes for distant assets, reducing polygon count from >3000 to 8 per tree.
[*] Save-system optimizations for faster loading and reduced network traffic.
[*] Database optimizations to prevent frame drops in certain situations.
[/list]


[h2]🍬 BONUS CLIP[/h2]
We would like to show you the rain system that isn´t shown in the devlog. In it, you can see how the environment reacts to rain.

[previewyoutube=v9VyaFzTM9k;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dev-Update: Airship facelift + new flight physic
notes.content:
Hey Solarpunk community!

We're back with another exhilarating update on the Solarpunk frontier! 🌞✈️

[h2]🚀 Airship Makeover Extravaganza![/h2]

We have adjusted the look of the airship. Among the new features are the ingenious directional propellers, which are now clearly visible in 3rd person mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/2202901bf79fcead00bc34faa2563829ba8653fe.png[/img]

Get ready to fly through the skies in style! 🌪️ Check out the stunning visual overhaul in the attached images.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/2df3498f2f77d1f88cdfdfdb285d8e45e76c81bb.jpg[/img]

[h2]🛠️ Dock & new flight physics! [/h2]
Remember that Dock concept we teased last time? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/dd17afc240d9a47ce03bd0baa397bf3ee240d168.png[/img]

Well, buckle up, because it's officially in the game! You can upgrade your airship at the dock. The airship will land automatically as soon as you are near it and press the docking-button.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/d73ae49b3246474f037bfb71906c30d00cbd9a86.png[/img][/th]
        [th] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/c7df1cc4a3e8378ce0c5777a6f7b5b3350831c56.png[/img][/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

We have also reworked the flight physics. The airship now flies much more comfortably. Fun fact: At the time we produced the trailer, the flying was extremely spongy and not polished at all. But it was enough for the trailer :D 

Take a look at the dock + the flight physics in this little clip.

[previewyoutube=LRfBbiSYJh0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🩹Damage system[/h2]
The airship now has a damage system. If you're not careful and hit something, it takes damage. From 50% damage it starts to smoke and is much more difficult to steer. If the damage reaches 100% or you crash directly into a wall at high speed, it breaks immediately. You will be able to craft repair kits to repair your airship. The hull can be upgraded later in the game so that the airship doesn't break so quickly.

🚧 A lot of what you see is still WIP and may differ from the final product! 🚧

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/81de8af99f604d2dd435f583260a7fe66c8eb71f.jpg[/img]

[h2]📖 Airship manual[/h2]
In case you're wondering what all the Buttons/indicators mean, here's an explanation for those who like lists :).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/3a419f2a540fe729fba537efc50972c06844fd7c.png[/img]

[b]Throttle:[/b]

Forward speed
Reverse gear

[b]Docking Indicators:[/b]

Upper lamp: Indicates whether you can dock in the open. (Works everywhere as long as the airship is stationary and relatively straight. You can also dock in mid-air, for example)

Lower lamp: Indicates if you can dock at a dock (if the dock is within a radius of approx. 5 meters, you can dock there automatically)

[b]Battery / Solar panel[/b]

[list]
[*] Battery is charged by the solar panel when exposed to sunlight
[*] Charges less quickly in the morning and evening than in the midday sun
[*] Also dependent on the weather. In the rain it charges slowly, in sunshine it charges quickly
[*] If covered by shade, also less charging power
[*] Flying consumes battery
[*] The faster you fly, the more energy the airship needs
[*] The small rotors also consume energy
[*] Light also consumes energy. (If you land at night and forget to switch off the light, your battery runs down because the solar panel does not charge the battery at night. So you shouldn't forget to switch the lights off again. Just like in a car)
[*] Solar charging indicator Indicates whether the battery is currently being charged or not
[/list]

[b]Altitude indicator[/b]

[list]
[*] Shows how far the airship is from the minimum and maximum altitude
[*] If the altitude is too low or too high, the autopilot switches on and automatically pulls the airship up/down again
[/list]

[b]Camera[/b]

[list]
[*] Free look around while flying
[*] 1st/3rd person camera
[/list]

[b]Upgradeables:[/b]

Things that are not available from the start, but can be upgraded as the game progresses

[list]
[*] Chest: The chest is not in the airship from the start, and you have to install it first
[*] Holographic display: The Holo HUD is currently still very wip. It will show additional information such as exactly how much power is being consumed, how much the solarpanel charges and other information such as the level of damage taken, flight altitude, time, etc
[/list]

[table]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/197dd350bfbd5868411b5ea1350204ebf9f8afa2.png[/img] [/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/a4dba00a14cda425864b2eee4e43d3ea7decadc2.png[/img] [/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[list]
[*] Battery storage can be upgraded
[*] Solar panel charging speed can be upgraded
[*] Engine (more speed)
[*] Hull (less damage from collisions)
[*] Balloon can be upgraded so that you can fly higher overall with the airship
[/list]

[h2]What do you think of these adjustments?[/h2]
That's it for today. We would be delighted if you could tell us what you think about the adjustments in the comments. 

- Best regards from Cyberwave

[url=https://twitter.com/Solarpunk_Game][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/53279aad73327dbdd6457ef59d540154d9c2b29a.png[/img][/url]
